summary: I fixed the zero-portfolio CTA loop by making the Portfolio panel's and FX Rates panel's empty-state CTAs open the Welcome banner's in-page "Create Portfolio" form (and scroll to it) instead of linking to `/portfolio` when the user has no portfolio yet, so new users can now act directly on Overview instead of bouncing to a dead-end Portfolio page. — researched from the venture's brain (semantic), planned as a PRP with 8 validation gate(s) (written), then passed on round 2 of 2 (earlier rounds failed — round 1: /review didn't clear this to ship: Zero-portfolio CTA loop: OverviewPage.tsx Portfolio panel ('Add your first card' -> /portfolio) and FxRatesPanel.tsx ('Set base currency' -> /portfolio) both link to /portfolio, but DashboardPage.tsx:102-116 shows only 'Go to Overview to create one' for zero-portfolio users, bouncing new users back to Overview instead of letting them act.) against them plus tests, /review review pass (0 critical) and /qa: Booted backend (:3001) + frontend (:5173) with existing seeded db and drove the flow in headless Chromium (Playwright). Signup redirects to /overview; first-run user sees 'Welcome to ARCA' banner there (not on Portfolio page); all 9 Overview panels (Set Indices, Top Movers, Price Chart, Portfolio, Price Alerts, Market Intel by Era, FX Rates, Market Stats, Grading Premiums) show genuine no-fake-data empty states with a one-line explanation + single CTA, no invented numbers. Creating a portfolio via the inline form removes the welcome banner, and the Portfolio panel switches to a real 'Add your first card' CTA; Portfolio page itself never shows the welcome state. No console/page errors during the flow, no server errors in logs. tsc -b shows only pre-existing unused-import errors unrelated to the changed files. Minor non-blocking nit: on first-run the FX Rates panel's CTA is labeled 'Set base currency' but opens the 'Create Your Portfolio' form (which does include a base-currency field) rather than a dedicated currency setting — acceptable since currency can only be set via that form pre-portfolio, not filed as a bug..
